chapter: Scrapbook: Blue Room acts and the United Fruit ship
title: Playing on the United Fruit ships to Guatemala
summary: Riddick recalls Puerto Barrios, Guatemala, three years on United Fruit ships, 72 trips to Havana, and trading apples for pineapples.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Right. Sonny Schuyler. Oh, yeah. And Schuyler. Sonny Schuyler wrote some fine tunes. Mm-hmm. Enjoy yourself. It's later than you think. This is one of the most unique things that I... This was down in Puerto Barrios in Guatemala.

And at that time, and this is 1935 and 36 and 37, they only... There was no refrigeration whatsoever, and they only slaughtered enough cattle one time at a time to feed this little community. And this is where the United Fruit Company shipped, docked to load bananas. Mm-hmm. And all of the cows' heads and everything that they did not use at the time, they threw outside.

And the buzzards were the scavengers. And this huge dog also lived there. And it was one of the most unique pictures that I have ever made in my life. Mm-hmm. Of these buzzards and all this dog, all feasting off of this head of this cattle that was just slaughtered.
What were you doing down there?
Playing on a United Fruit Company ship. Mm-hmm. Three years. I've been in Havana, Cuba 72 times in my life.
So when you went on a United Fruit Company ship, y'all would stay gone a right good while.
Sixteen days, one trip, and eight days, another trip.
You've got the billboard for September the 2nd, 1950.

We had the same food that the passengers had. We had the same dining room that the passengers had. And you just got to where it was such rich food and everything, you got so tired of it, that honest to goodness, we would steal an apple and bring it to the side of the ship. And a native would come out in a dugout and bring you a sugar loaf pineapple that tall, ripe right off of the vine. The juice poured out of you. And for that apple, he would give you the pineapple.
